handoff.reason: Two defects, both of the exact shape you have already repaired on this book. The approving Review states its nineteen node registrations in prose and carries no executable node_registry_decisions block, so the Integrator reads zero approved registrations and fifteen endpoints dangle. The Approved manifest also declares no operation_index, which is the same packaging defect INT-20260922-001 recorded for Stats. Neither a GUP revision nor a new source reading is implied: GUP-PKT-SD-011-014-character-overview-and-starting-level-r03 already proposes all nineteen nodes.

blocking_failures.check: the approving Review declares executable node registrations
blocking_failures.detail: REV-GUP-PKT-SD-011-014-character-overview-and-starting-level-r03-r01 contains no node_registry_decisions block. Its completeness_statement asserts that 'nineteen node registrations are source-supported, mechanically complete, and approval-ready', and the reviewed GUP proposes nineteen nodes, but a registration stated only in prose is not executable, so the Integrator registers nothing.

blocking_failures.check: every edge endpoint resolves to a canonical node or a node this batch registers (invariant 1)
blocking_failures.detail: APPROVED-GUP-PKT-SD-011-014-character-overview-and-starting-level-r03-r01: target_id=rule_gear_capacity is not a canonical node and is not registered by this batch (invariant 1). The transaction aborts on the first unresolved endpoint; the complete set of fifteen is enumerated in unresolved_endpoints below.

advisory_failures.check: operation classification is declared, not inferred
advisory_failures.detail: bundle carries no operation_index; every CSV row read as an addition. In a batch that registers its own endpoints every such row is a pending_addition, which is the packaging defect INT-20260922-001 recorded for the Stats bundle.

unresolved_endpoints.note: Measured against the current registry, which holds 30 rows after INT-20260922-002 and INT-20260922-003. Four endpoints now resolve against canonical state that did not exist when this bundle was first offered, which is why the transaction's first reported failure moved from abil_constitution to rule_gear_capacity. The underlying defect is unchanged.

what_is_not_in_dispute.summary: This record disputes no source reading, no assertion, no edge semantics, no node identity and no citation.
what_is_not_in_dispute.components_resolve: The manifest's declared components resolve by repository-relative path and every declared checksum matches the bytes on disk.
what_is_not_in_dispute.review_is_approved: The Review declares status approved, overall_disposition approved, approval_ready true, and a ready Integrator handoff. The defect is the absent registration block, not the disposition.
what_is_not_in_dispute.gup_is_correct: GUP-PKT-SD-011-014-character-overview-and-starting-level-r03 proposes all nineteen nodes. The Builder output is not implicated and needs no revision.

defect_attribution.primary: An approving Review must carry node_registry_decisions for every node the batch registers. Prose in completeness_statement is not executable.
defect_attribution.secondary: The Approved manifest must declare the reviewed GUP's operation_index so rows that depend on this batch's own registrations are classified as pending_additions rather than plain additions.
not_a_defect_in: the reviewed GUP, which proposes the nineteen nodes
the edge component, whose 21 rows and checksum are exactly as declared
the Integrator tooling, whose genesis and queue-derivation behaviour were independently approved in REV-IMP-DEC-2026-0092-r01-r01 and are evidenced again in IMP-DEC-2026-0096-r01

remediation.precedent: This is the same two-step repair already completed on this book: REV-GUP-PKT-SD-015-015-stats-and-stat-modifiers-r05-r02 added the registration block and APPROVED-GUP-PKT-SD-015-015-stats-and-stat-modifiers-r05-r05 added the operation_index, after which INT-20260922-002 applied cleanly. REV-GUP-PKT-SD-016-017-ancestries-r02-r02 and its successor bundle did both in one step and INT-20260922-003 applied cleanly.
remediation.action: Publish a successor Review carrying node_registry_decisions for all nineteen nodes the reviewed GUP proposes, each with its own proposed_id, submitted_label, kind and an approved disposition, then a successor Approved bundle that consumes that Review, keeps the same components and checksums, and declares additions: [] with pending_additions listing csv_row 1 through 21.
remediation.verification_the_integrator_will_repeat: Every declared checksum against disk, active-leaf status of Review and bundle, a non-zero count of approved node registrations, then a dry run reporting zero blocking failures before any canonical file is written.

canonical_state.statement: No canonical file was created, modified or removed. The rejection was decided inside a dry run that wrote nothing, and canonical is byte-identical to the state INT-20260922-003 left. The invariant suite reports 0 findings over 35 edges and 30 nodes under Constitution 1.4.
